invariants.rationale: The method iterates over nodes, which implies it should not be null.
The method checks node.actor.getY() between low and high; it is likely that low is less than or equal to high.
Array.size in libGDX is always non-negative.
low is used in comparisons; it is likely intended to be a finite float.
high is used in comparisons; it is likely intended to be a finite float.
